status: First quantitative microscopy and physical evaluation complete; causal interventions and matched dense PG oracle pending.
user_scope: Weights, layers, gradients, policy gradient and optimizer, and the gap to strong locomotion. Generic data-reuse or hyperparameter explanations are outside the requested focus.

model.policy_gradient: g(theta) = E[J_logits(theta,s)^T score_logits(a|s) A(s,a)]. Correct optimizer algebra cannot repair an inaccurate A, a poorly conditioned logits Jacobian, or missing behavioral directions.
model.actual_matrix_step: DeltaW = normalize_axis(W - eta D) - W. For unit rows or columns, DeltaW is approximately -eta [D - W sum_axis(W D)]. Polarizing a gradient, projecting it onto the constraint tangent and transporting it through the network Jacobian do not commute.
model.functional_update: Delta logits = sum_layers J_layer DeltaW_layer plus head and gain contributions. The policy-Fisher cost includes cross-layer terms; summing isolated costs can miss cancellation or reinforcement.
model.actor_readout: z = diag(gain) [W_head * 8 normalize(h_first + normalize(branch_second)) + bias]. Gate derivatives, normalization projectors, feature geometry, head orientations and row gains determine the actual control direction.
model.beta_control: alpha,beta=1+softplus(z); c=alpha+beta; physical mean=2 alpha/c-1; variance=4 alpha beta/[c^2(c+1)]. Mean derivative w.r.t. z_alpha is 2 beta sigmoid(z_alpha)/c^2; w.r.t. z_beta it is -2 alpha sigmoid(z_beta)/c^2. Large near-boundary mean torques can become poorly conditioned in these logits.
model.value_error_transport: For V=V_pi+e, with V_pi the true value of the current policy (not the globally optimal value), and away from finite boundaries, GAE advantage error = -e(s_t) + gamma(1-lambda) sum_k (gamma lambda)^k e(s_(t+k+1)). Current-state baseline error cancels in expected fresh unclipped policy score; successor errors can be action dependent. Later clipped PPO masks require separate treatment. Self-bootstrapped explained variance does not measure this bias.
model.physical_optimum: A high-return gait is a closed-loop dynamical behavior. The local policy gradient around the current gait and a globally better gait are different objects; no global optimum is known from current checkpoints. Compare true physical action-credit and stronger verified evaluation policies before attributing the gap to optimization speed.
model.local_functional_optimum: For measured conditional finite-horizon logit score gradient g_z and Beta Fisher F_z, unrestricted per-state steepest motion is proportional to inverse(F_z) g_z. Its fixed-cost Cauchy bound provides a local functional upper bound. Projection through the actual network tangent and JVP/VJP distinguishes model reachability from optimizer efficiency. This is not the globally optimal gait and can overfit noisy oracle estimates.

hypotheses.exact_fact: The actor head is initialized with output_std=.01, then its rows are normalized to unit length while readout_gain starts at one. That normalization removes the intended small row scale.
hypotheses.test: Measure initialized logits and Beta mean/concentration before head-only and full projection using identical weights and labeled input distributions. Test restoring the intended gain only if actual gradient/behavior measurements support it.
hypotheses.causal_status: Performance effect unestablished; shared by Adam and Anvil, so it cannot by itself explain their relative ordering.

hypotheses.exact_fact: For the bias-free SiTU product, even part = .5 cap(g) cap(u), odd part = even part*tanh(g/2). The leading small-input response is quadratic and even; its Jacobian at zero is zero. Normalization removes the leading radial magnitude.
hypotheses.test: Measure odd/even energy, signed-velocity sensitivity, radial/tangent Jacobian spectra and normalization contraction on real visited observations, separately from algebraic scaled/negated probes.
hypotheses.causal_status: Actual standardized observations are not generally infinitesimal. A blanket claim that sign information is lost is unsupported.

hypotheses.exact_fact: The optimizer operates in ambient matrix coordinates, followed by unit-axis retraction. Stored momentum need not lie in the current tangent space.
hypotheses.test: Measure radial fractions of gradients, rails and directions; before/after-retraction PG gain; functional singular-mode energy and cross-layer Fisher Gram. Compare projection-before-cascade and projection-after-cascade as labeled counterfactuals.
hypotheses.causal_status: A radial component is not always a pure gauge for nonlinear gates. Projected optimization is appropriate to the existing constraint but may not improve the constrained architecture.

hypotheses.exact_fact: alpha,beta>=1 implies |physical mean|<=1-2/c. Mode and mean differ: physical mode = c/(c-2) times physical mean, where c>2. Learned gains can increase c, so this is a conditioning constraint rather than a fixed capacity ceiling.
hypotheses.test: Measure reachable torques and output derivatives, then actual sample/mean/mode checkpoint return, velocity, control cost and gait. Determine whether near-boundary torque is useful before changing parameterization.
hypotheses.causal_status: No evidence yet that the optimal gait requires actuator saturation or that deterministic evaluation will approach20k.

hypotheses.exact_fact: Existing snapshots omit transition rewards, boundary masks and simulator states. They do not identify independent value error or true action credit.
hypotheses.test: Measure available per-layer critic Jacobians and score-baseline sampling noise; collect independent paired-state physical continuation returns and score-weighted successor error with explicit finite-horizon/tail limitations.
hypotheses.causal_status: High explained variance and small critic residuals against its own targets cannot establish accurate PG; low gain is not a supported value-range ceiling.

previous_falsifications: Fractional singular weighting improved selected tangent alignments but caused approximately4x policy displacement at equal parameter norms.
Correcting that matrix-only policy budget did not improve returns; v11 primary8074 versus matched cascade8632. Scalar functional step calibration is insufficient.
Sample-Fisher head calibration corrected exact local KL amplitude, but both matched Anvil and Adam fresh returns worsened. Fixing this approximation did not cure learning.
Large critic or actor gradient clipping starvation is unsupported: observed norms are well below the independent .5 caps.

limitations: These are analytic facts and testable mechanisms, not completed causal explanations of the return gap.
Local policy-Fisher/JVP diagnostics do not establish environment-return improvement.
The global optimum is unknown. Published checkpoint-evaluation scores and sampled training returns require protocol matching.
All model/GPU diagnostics and fresh training must run through mlq; no GPU measurements have been launched by the root committee yet.
